court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: Tamil Nadu Waqf Board, Rep. by its Chief Exective Officer … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Petitioner(s): Mr. A. Ajimath Begam
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of writ of mandamus directing the respondent to consider the petitioner application dated 10-9-2021 and to conduct enquiry by placing the matter before the Board in the fore coming Board meeting of the respondent and there by to appoint muthawaali to the Abdullah Khan Bailim pallivasal Waqf (574/TNV) under Section 32 of the waqf Act, 1995 within a stipulagted period of time.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

M. Dhandapani, J.:— When the matter is taken up for hearing, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this writ petition. He also made an endorsement to that effect.

2. In view of the above, this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs.
